arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Stancil argued the city left the sides that brought the case paying thirty times more. He stated this happened because they paid their tax bills in full.
Mr. Clement stated the city abandoned the Barrett Law. He noted the program had proved unpopular for financing public improvements.
Justice Breyer questioned why the state does not refund money to those who paid. He emphasized this is a matter of constitutional law.
Justice Sotomayor asked about other amnesty programs. She mentioned immigration status amnesty and illegal entry forgiveness.

paragraphs: the sides that brought the case argue the city treated them unequally. They paid full assessments while others received waivers. This violates the Equal Protection Clause.
